text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "We invite you to visit our social media channels and interact with us and other people.", "severity": 0.2, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "The comment columns are intended as a place for lively debate.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Netiquette rules"}, {"side": "en", "quote": "You can contribute to an atmosphere of respect and polite behaviour by observing the following:", "severity": 0.2, "before": "We invite you to visit our social media channels and interact with us and other people."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Auch Sie können zu einem angenehmen Klima beitragen.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Die Kommentarspalten sollen ein Ort der lebendigen Debatte sein."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Hierfür haben wir Ihnen die wichtigsten Punkte zusammengestellt:", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Alle Nutzerinnen und Nutzer haben das Recht, in den Kommentarspalten unserer Social-Media-Kanäle ihre Meinung kundzutun."}]}
